name: Sambar
steps: Pressure cook toor dal with turmeric and 2 cups water for 3 whistles; mash well.
Soak tamarind in 1 cup warm water for 10 minutes and squeeze out the juice.
Boil chopped carrot, beans, onion and tomato in the tamarind water with salt for 10 minutes.
Add sambar powder and the mashed dal; simmer for 8 minutes.
Heat oil, crackle mustard seeds, add hing and curry leaves, and pour this tempering over the sambar.

name: Tomato Rasam
steps: Pressure cook toor dal for 3 whistles and mash.
Boil chopped tomatoes with tamarind water, crushed garlic, pepper and salt for 8 minutes.
Add rasam powder and the dal with 2 cups water; bring to a froth but do not boil hard.
Temper mustard, cumin and curry leaves in oil; add to the rasam.
Finish with chopped coriander and serve hot with rice.

name: Bisi Bele Bath
steps: Wash rice and dal together and pressure cook with turmeric and 5 cups water for 4 whistles.
Cook chopped vegetables in tamarind water with salt until soft.
Mix vegetables, sambar powder and the rice-dal; simmer for 5 minutes, adding hot water to keep it loose.
Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves and cashews in ghee.
Pour the tempering on top and serve hot.

name: Curd Rice
steps: Cook rice soft with 3 cups water (3 whistles or rice cooker) and let it cool.
Mash the rice lightly and mix in curd, milk and salt.
Heat oil; add mustard seeds, chopped ginger, green chilli and curry leaves.
Pour the tempering over the rice, mix and top with coriander.

name: Lemon Rice (Chitranna)
steps: Cook rice so the grains stay separate and spread it out to cool.
Heat oil; fry peanuts, chana dal and mustard seeds until golden.
Add green chilli, curry leaves and turmeric, then switch off the heat.
Add the rice, salt and lemon juice and mix gently.

name: Tomato Rice
steps: Wash and soak rice for 15 minutes.
Sauté onion, ginger, garlic and green chilli in oil until golden.
Add chopped tomatoes, chilli powder and garam masala; cook until mushy.
Add rice, mint, salt and 2 1/2 cups water; pressure cook for 2 whistles.

name: Vangi Bath
steps: Cook rice and keep aside to cool.
Fry mustard seeds, peanuts and curry leaves in oil, then add sliced onion.
Add brinjal strips with salt; cover and cook for 8 minutes until soft.
Stir in tamarind water and sambar powder; cook for 3 minutes.
Fold in the rice and mix well.

name: Puliyogare
steps: Cook rice and cool it on a plate.
Boil thick tamarind extract with jaggery, salt and sambar powder until it thickens like a paste.
Fry peanuts, chana dal, mustard seeds, red chilli and curry leaves in oil.
Mix the paste and the tempering into the rice and rest for 10 minutes.

name: Coconut Rice
steps: Cook rice and cool it.
Fry mustard seeds, chana dal and cashews in oil; add green chilli and curry leaves.
Add grated coconut and roast for 2 minutes.
Add rice and salt, mix gently and serve.

name: Jeera Rice
steps: Soak basmati rice for 20 minutes.
Heat ghee and crackle the cumin.
Add the drained rice, salt and 2 cups water.
Cook covered on low heat for 12 minutes (or 1 whistle), then fluff and add coriander.

name: Veg Pulao
steps: Soak rice for 20 minutes.
Fry sliced onion in ghee until golden; add ginger-garlic.
Add chopped vegetables and garam masala; sauté for 3 minutes.
Add rice, mint, salt and 2 cups water; pressure cook for 2 whistles.

name: Cabbage Moong Kootu
steps: Pressure cook moong dal with turmeric for 2 whistles.
Boil shredded cabbage with salt until just soft.
Grind coconut, cumin and green chilli to a paste.
Mix dal, cabbage and paste; simmer 5 minutes.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves in oil and add.

name: Avial
steps: Cut vegetables into long batons.
Cook them with turmeric, salt and a little water until tender.
Grind coconut, cumin and green chilli coarsely and add to the vegetables.
Stir in whisked curd and warm through without boiling.
Finish with coconut oil and curry leaves.

name: Beans Palya
steps: Chop beans finely.
Fry mustard seeds, urad dal, red chilli and curry leaves in oil.
Add beans, salt and a splash of water; cover and cook for 8 minutes.
Add grated coconut and mix for 1 minute.

name: Cabbage Palya
steps: Shred the cabbage finely.
Temper mustard seeds, chana dal, green chilli and curry leaves in oil.
Add cabbage, turmeric and salt; cook uncovered for 8 minutes.
Add coconut, mix and serve.

name: Potato Palya
steps: Pressure cook potatoes for 3 whistles, peel and crumble.
Fry mustard seeds, onion, green chilli and curry leaves in oil.
Add turmeric, potatoes and salt; mix and cook for 4 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

name: Bhindi Fry
steps: Wash and dry the bhindi completely, then slice.
Fry in hot oil on medium heat for 10 minutes, stirring gently.
Add sliced onion and cook for 4 minutes.
Add spice powders and salt; cook 2 more minutes.

name: Palak Dal
steps: Pressure cook dal with turmeric for 3 whistles.
Fry cumin, garlic and onion in oil until golden.
Add tomato and chilli powder; cook soft.
Add chopped spinach and cook 3 minutes.
Add the dal and salt; simmer 5 minutes.

name: Majjige Huli
steps: Soak chana dal for 20 minutes.
Cook diced bottle gourd in salted water until tender.
Grind coconut, chana dal, ginger and chilli to a paste.
Add paste and whisked curd to the vegetable and heat gently without boiling.
Temper mustard seeds and curry leaves and pour over.

name: Ragi Mudde
steps: Boil 3 cups water with salt.
Add ragi flour in a heap without stirring and cook covered for 3 minutes.
Stir vigorously with a wooden stick until no lumps remain.
Cook on low for 5 minutes, then shape into balls with wet hands.
Serve with sambar or soppu saaru.

name: South Indian Meals
steps: Cook rice and pressure cook toor dal.
Make sambar with half the dal, carrot, beans, tamarind and sambar powder.
Make rasam with the rest of the dal, tomatoes and rasam powder.
Make cabbage palya with coconut.
Serve rice with sambar, rasam, palya and curd.

name: Dal Tadka
steps: Wash dal and pressure cook with turmeric and 3 cups water for 3 whistles.
Heat ghee; add cumin, garlic, ginger and green chilli.
Add onion and cook until golden, then tomato until soft.
Add the dal, salt and chilli powder; simmer 5 minutes.
Garnish with coriander.

name: Dal Fry
steps: Pressure cook both dals with turmeric for 3 whistles.
Fry cumin, ginger, garlic and onion until golden.
Add tomato and spices; cook until oil separates.
Add the dal and salt; boil 5 minutes.

name: Masoor Dal
steps: Rinse masoor dal and boil with turmeric and 3 cups water for 15 minutes.
Fry cumin, garlic and onion in oil.
Add tomato and chilli powder; cook soft.
Mix into the dal with salt and simmer 3 minutes.

name: Chana Masala
steps: Soak chana overnight; pressure cook with salt for 5 whistles.
Fry onion, ginger and garlic until brown.
Add tomato and chole masala; cook until thick.
Add chana with some cooking water; simmer 10 minutes and mash a few.
Garnish with coriander.

name: Rajma Masala
steps: Soak rajma overnight; pressure cook for 6 whistles until very soft.
Fry cumin, onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add tomato puree and spices; cook 8 minutes.
Add rajma and 1 cup of its water; simmer 15 minutes.

name: Dal Makhani
steps: Soak urad dal and rajma overnight; pressure cook for 8 whistles.
Cook onion, ginger, garlic and tomato puree in butter.
Add dal and spices and simmer on low for 20 minutes, stirring.
Stir in milk and a little more butter before serving.

name: Moong Dal Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and dal together.
Heat ghee; add cumin, hing and ginger.
Add vegetables, rice, dal, turmeric, salt and 5 cups water.
Pressure cook for 4 whistles and serve with curd.

name: Palak Paneer
steps: Blanch spinach for 2 minutes, cool and blend to a puree.
Fry cumin, onion, ginger, garlic and chilli in oil.
Add tomato and cook soft, then the spinach puree and salt; simmer 5 minutes.
Add paneer cubes and garam masala; cook 3 minutes.

name: Paneer Butter Masala
steps: Cook tomato, onion, cashews, ginger and garlic with a little water for 10 minutes; blend smooth.
Melt butter, add the puree and spices; cook 8 minutes.
Add milk, sugar and salt; simmer 3 minutes.
Add paneer cubes and simmer 3 more minutes.

name: Matar Paneer
steps: Fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add tomato and spices; cook until oil separates.
Add peas and 1 cup water; cook 8 minutes.
Add paneer cubes and simmer 4 minutes.

name: Kadai Paneer
steps: Fry capsicum and onion chunks in a hot kadai for 3 minutes and set aside.
In the same oil cook ginger, garlic and tomato with the spices.
Add paneer and the fried vegetables; toss on high heat for 3 minutes.

name: Paneer Bhurji
steps: Fry onion and green chilli until soft.
Add tomato, capsicum and spices; cook 4 minutes.
Crumble in the paneer, add salt and cook 3 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

name: Aloo Gobi
steps: Fry cumin and ginger in oil, then onion until soft.
Add potato cubes and spices; cook 5 minutes.
Add cauliflower, tomato and salt; cover and cook on low for 15 minutes, stirring now and then.

name: Aloo Matar
steps: Fry cumin, ginger and onion.
Add tomato and spices; cook soft.
Add diced potato, peas, salt and 2 cups water.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles and garnish.

name: Jeera Aloo
steps: Boil potatoes for 3 whistles, peel and cube.
Crackle cumin in hot oil and add green chilli.
Add potatoes, spices and salt; toss on medium heat for 6 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

name: Baingan Bharta
steps: Roast the brinjals directly on the gas flame until the skin chars and the inside is soft.
Cool, peel and mash the flesh.
Fry cumin, garlic, onion and chilli in oil; add tomato and cook soft.
Add the mash, chilli powder and salt; cook 5 minutes.

name: Mixed Veg Curry
steps: Fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add tomato and spices; cook until the oil separates.
Add chopped vegetables, salt and 1 cup water.
Cover and cook for 15 minutes until tender.

name: Bhindi Masala
steps: Fry sliced bhindi in half the oil until not slimy; set aside.
Fry cumin, garlic and onion in the rest of the oil.
Add tomato and spices; cook soft.
Add bhindi and salt; cook 4 minutes.

name: Lauki Chana Dal
steps: Soak chana dal for 30 minutes.
Fry cumin, ginger and onion; add tomato and spices.
Add dal, diced lauki, salt and 3 cups water.
Pressure cook for 4 whistles.

name: Soya Chunks Curry
steps: Boil soya chunks in salted water for 5 minutes; squeeze out the water.
Fry onion, ginger and garlic until brown.
Add tomato and spices; cook until thick.
Add soya chunks and 1 1/2 cups water; simmer 10 minutes.

name: Mushroom Masala
steps: Fry onion, ginger and garlic.
Add tomato and spices; cook 6 minutes.
Add sliced mushrooms and capsicum; cook on high for 6 minutes until the water dries.

name: Veg Biryani
steps: Soak rice for 20 minutes.
Fry sliced onion in ghee until brown; add ginger and garlic.
Add vegetables, curd, biryani masala, mint and salt; cook 5 minutes.
Add rice and 2 1/2 cups water; pressure cook for 2 whistles and rest 10 minutes.

name: Moong Sprouts Curry
steps: Soak moong overnight and sprout for a day.
Fry cumin, garlic and onion; add tomato and spices.
Add sprouts, coconut, salt and 2 cups water.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles.

name: Kadhi
steps: Whisk curd, besan, turmeric and 3 cups water smoothly.
Bring to a boil while stirring, then simmer for 15 minutes.
Temper cumin, mustard, curry leaves, onion, ginger and chilli in oil.
Pour into the kadhi and add salt.

name: Tofu Bhurji
steps: Press water out of the tofu and crumble it.
Fry cumin, onion and chilli; add tomato and capsicum.
Add tofu, turmeric and salt; cook 5 minutes.
Finish with coriander.

name: Matar Pulao
steps: Soak rice 20 minutes.
Fry cumin and onion in ghee.
Add peas, garam masala, rice, salt and 2 cups water.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles.

name: Egg Curry
steps: Boil eggs for 10 minutes (or 1 whistle), peel and slit lightly.
Fry onion, ginger and garlic until golden.
Add tomato and spices; cook until thick.
Add 1 1/2 cups water and the eggs; simmer 8 minutes.

name: Egg Bhurji
steps: Fry onion and green chilli until soft.
Add tomato and spices; cook 3 minutes.
Pour in beaten eggs and scramble on medium heat until set.
Add salt and coriander.

name: Egg Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice and cool it completely.
Scramble the eggs in a little oil and set aside.
Stir-fry garlic, onion and vegetables on high heat for 3 minutes.
Add rice, eggs, soy sauce, pepper and salt; toss for 2 minutes.

name: Masala Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with salt.
Mix in finely chopped onion, tomato, chilli and coriander.
Pour onto a hot oiled tawa and cook 2 minutes per side.

name: Bread Omelette
steps: Beat eggs with onion, chilli and salt.
Pour onto a buttered tawa and place 2 bread slices on top while it is wet.
Flip, fold the edges over the bread and toast both sides.

name: Egg Sandwich
steps: Boil eggs for 10 minutes, peel and chop.
Mix with onion, pepper and salt.
Spread on buttered bread and toast in the sandwich maker.

name: Egg Pepper Masala
steps: Boil and halve the eggs.
Fry onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves.
Add pepper, turmeric and salt.
Toss in the eggs gently for 2 minutes.

name: Chicken Curry
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, turmeric, chilli and salt for 20 minutes.
Fry onion until deep brown, then ginger and garlic.
Add tomato and spice powders; cook until oil separates.
Add chicken and cook covered for 25 minutes, adding water as needed.

name: Chicken Biryani
steps: Marinate chicken with curd, biryani masala, ginger, garlic and salt for 30 minutes.
Soak rice for 20 minutes.
Fry onions brown in ghee and oil; add tomato and the chicken and cook 10 minutes.
Add rice, mint and 3 cups water.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles and rest 10 minutes before opening.

name: Pepper Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken with turmeric and salt.
Fry onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves.
Add chicken and coriander powder; cook covered for 20 minutes.
Add plenty of crushed pepper and roast dry for 5 minutes.

name: Chicken Tikka
steps: Mix curd, tandoori masala, ginger, garlic, lemon juice and salt.
Coat boneless chicken, capsicum and onion and marinate for 1 hour.
Air fry at 200°C for 14 minutes (or bake at 220°C for 20 minutes), turning halfway.
Brush with oil and cook 2 more minutes.

name: Mangalore Fish Curry
steps: Grind coconut, red chillies, coriander powder, turmeric, garlic and tamarind to a smooth paste.
Fry onion and curry leaves in oil.
Add the paste and 2 cups water; boil 8 minutes.
Add fish pieces and salt; simmer gently for 8 minutes.

name: Tawa Fish Fry
steps: Marinate fish with chilli, turmeric, garlic, lemon and salt for 20 minutes.
Coat each piece in rava.
Shallow fry on a hot tawa for 4 minutes per side until crisp.

name: Mutton Curry
steps: Marinate mutton with curd, turmeric and salt.
Fry onion until brown, then ginger and garlic.
Add tomato and spices; cook 5 minutes.
Add mutton and 2 cups water; pressure cook for 6 whistles.

name: Prawn Masala
steps: Clean prawns and marinate with turmeric and salt.
Fry onion, ginger, garlic and curry leaves.
Add tomato, chilli and coconut; cook 5 minutes.
Add prawns and cook 6 minutes until pink.

name: Butter Chicken
steps: Marinate chicken in curd and tandoori masala; pan-sear until cooked.
Cook tomato, cashews, ginger and garlic for 10 minutes and blend.
Simmer the sauce with butter, chilli, sugar and salt for 10 minutes.
Add chicken and milk; simmer 5 minutes.

name: Chicken Sukka
steps: Dry-roast coconut until brown and grind coarsely with red chillies, pepper and coriander.
Fry onion and garlic in ghee.
Add chicken, turmeric and salt; cook covered 20 minutes.
Add the coconut masala and roast dry for 8 minutes.

name: Idli
steps: Soak rice and urad dal separately for 5 hours.
Grind into a smooth batter, mix with salt and ferment overnight.
Pour into greased idli plates.
Steam in the pressure cooker without the whistle for 12 minutes.

name: Masala Dosa
steps: Make dosa batter: soak rice and urad dal 5 hours, grind and ferment overnight with salt.
Boil and crumble potatoes.
Fry mustard seeds, onion, chilli and curry leaves; add turmeric, potatoes and salt for the palya.
Spread batter thin on a hot tawa, drizzle ghee and cook until crisp.
Fill with the potato palya and fold.

name: Plain Dosa
steps: Soak rice and urad dal 5 hours and grind to a batter.
Add salt and ferment overnight.
Spread a ladle of batter thin on a hot tawa.
Drizzle oil and cook until golden and crisp.

name: Set Dosa
steps: Soak rice, urad dal and poha for 5 hours; grind and ferment overnight.
Pour thick small dosas on the tawa.
Cover and cook on one side until spongy.
Serve in sets of three with chutney and sagu.

name: Rava Dosa
steps: Mix rava, rice flour and maida with 3 cups water into a thin batter; rest 20 minutes.
Add onion, chilli, cumin, pepper and salt.
Pour the batter from a height onto a very hot tawa to make a lacy dosa.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.

name: Neer Dosa
steps: Soak rice 3 hours and grind with coconut into a very thin, watery batter.
Add salt; no fermentation is needed.
Pour onto a hot tawa, swirl, cover and cook 1 minute.
Fold into triangles without flipping.

name: Rava Idli
steps: Roast rava in ghee with mustard seeds, chana dal, cashews and curry leaves.
Cool, then mix with curd, grated carrot, salt and water; rest 15 minutes.
Pour into greased idli plates.
Steam for 12 minutes.

name: Upma
steps: Dry-roast rava until fragrant.
Fry mustard seeds, urad dal, ginger, chilli, curry leaves and onion in oil.
Add 2 1/2 cups water and salt; bring to a boil.
Stir in the rava slowly to avoid lumps; cover and cook 3 minutes.

name: Khara Bath
steps: Roast rava in a little ghee.
Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion and chilli; add tomato and vegetables.
Add 3 cups water and salt and boil.
Stir in rava and cook covered for 3 minutes; finish with ghee.

name: Kesari Bath
steps: Roast rava in ghee until golden; fry cashews and raisins.
Boil 2 cups water with milk.
Add rava slowly while stirring, then sugar and cardamom.
Cook until it leaves the sides of the pan; add the nuts.

name: Chow Chow Bath
steps: Make a half batch of khara bath with rava, vegetables and tempering.
Make a half batch of kesari bath with rava, ghee, sugar and cashews.
Serve both side by side on one plate.

name: Poha
steps: Rinse poha and let it soften for 5 minutes.
Fry peanuts, mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion, chilli and diced potato until cooked.
Add turmeric, salt and the poha; mix on low heat for 3 minutes.
Squeeze lemon on top.

name: Ven Pongal
steps: Roast moong dal lightly and wash with rice.
Pressure cook with 5 cups water for 4 whistles until mushy.
Fry pepper, cumin, ginger, cashews and curry leaves in ghee.
Mix the tempering and salt into the pongal.

name: Akki Rotti
steps: Mix rice flour with onion, carrot, coconut, chilli, coriander, cumin and salt.
Add warm water to make a soft dough.
Pat thin rounds directly on a greased cold tawa.
Cook covered on medium heat until golden on both sides.

name: Ragi Dosa
steps: Mix the flours with water into a thin batter; rest 15 minutes.
Add onion, chilli, cumin and salt.
Pour onto a hot tawa like a rava dosa.
Drizzle oil and cook until crisp.

name: Oats Upma
steps: Dry-roast oats for 3 minutes.
Fry mustard seeds, curry leaves, onion, chilli and vegetables.
Add 1 1/2 cups water and salt and boil.
Add oats and cook 3 minutes until soft.

name: Oats Porridge
steps: Cook oats in milk for 5 minutes, stirring (or microwave 3 minutes).
Sweeten with sugar.
Top with sliced banana.

name: Semiya Upma
steps: Roast vermicelli until golden.
Fry tempering, onion and vegetables.
Add 2 cups water and salt; boil.
Add vermicelli and cook until the water is absorbed.

name: Aloo Paratha
steps: Knead atta with water into a soft dough.
Mash boiled potatoes with onion, chilli, coriander, garam masala and salt.
Stuff dough balls with the filling and roll out.
Cook on a hot tawa with ghee until golden spots appear on both sides.

name: Methi Thepla
steps: Knead atta, besan, chopped methi, curd, spices and salt into a firm dough.
Rest for 15 minutes.
Roll thin rounds.
Cook on a hot tawa with a little oil on both sides.

name: Poori Sagu
steps: Knead a stiff atta dough with salt and rest 15 minutes.
Cook potato, carrot and peas; simmer with ground coconut-chilli and onion for the sagu.
Roll small rounds and deep fry in hot oil until they puff.
Serve hot with the sagu.

name: Besan Chilla
steps: Whisk besan with water into a smooth pancake batter.
Mix in onion, tomato, chilli, coriander, turmeric and salt.
Spread on a hot oiled tawa and cook 2 minutes per side.

name: Moong Dal Chilla
steps: Soak moong dal for 3 hours.
Grind with ginger and chilli into a smooth batter; add salt.
Spread on a hot tawa, sprinkle onion and coriander.
Cook with oil on both sides.

name: Pesarattu
steps: Soak green moong and rice for 6 hours.
Grind with ginger, chilli and cumin into a batter; add salt.
Spread thin on a hot tawa and top with onion.
Cook with oil until crisp.

name: Adai
steps: Soak rice and the three dals for 4 hours.
Grind coarsely with red chillies; add onion, curry leaves and salt.
Spread a thick dosa on a hot tawa, make a hole in the middle and add oil.
Cook on both sides until crisp.

name: Onion Uttapam
steps: Make and ferment dosa batter.
Pour a thick round on the tawa.
Top with onion, tomato, chilli and coriander and press lightly.
Cook with oil on both sides.

name: Veg Sandwich
steps: Boil and slice the potato.
Butter the bread.
Layer cucumber, tomato and potato with salt and pepper.
Toast in the sandwich maker for 4 minutes.

name: Paneer Paratha
steps: Knead a soft atta dough.
Mix grated paneer with onion, chilli, coriander, garam masala and salt.
Stuff, roll and cook on a hot tawa with ghee on both sides.

name: Idli Vada
steps: Steam idlis from fermented rice-urad batter.
Grind soaked urad dal into a fluffy batter for vadas; add onion, chilli and curry leaves.
Shape into rings and deep fry until golden.
Serve two idlis and one vada with sambar.

name: Medu Vada
steps: Soak urad dal for 4 hours and grind with very little water until fluffy.
Mix in onion, chilli, ginger, curry leaves, pepper and salt.
Shape into rings with wet hands.
Deep fry in hot oil until golden and crisp.

name: Chapati
steps: Knead atta, salt and water into a soft dough; rest 15 minutes.
Roll thin rounds.
Cook on a hot tawa, flipping until puffed, and brush with oil.

name: Steamed Rice
steps: Wash rice two or three times.
Cook with 3 times the water in a pressure cooker (3 whistles), a pot, or a rice cooker.
Rest 5 minutes and fluff.

name: Phulka & Moong Dal
steps: Boil moong dal with turmeric until soft; temper with cumin, onion and tomato.
Knead atta into a soft dough.
Roll and cook phulkas on the tawa, then puff them over the flame.
Serve hot with the dal.

name: Pav Bhaji
steps: Pressure cook potato, cauliflower and peas; mash.
Cook onion, capsicum and tomato in butter until soft.
Add the mash, pav bhaji masala, salt and a little water; mash and simmer 10 minutes.
Toast pav in butter and serve with lemon and onion.

name: Masala Vada
steps: Soak chana dal for 3 hours.
Grind coarsely without water.
Mix in onion, chilli, ginger, curry leaves and salt.
Shape flat patties and deep fry until crisp.

name: Onion Pakoda
steps: Slice onions thinly and rub with salt for 5 minutes.
Add besan, rice flour, chilli, curry leaves and chilli powder; sprinkle water to bind.
Drop small clumps into hot oil.
Fry until crisp and golden.

name: Mirchi Bajji
steps: Use large mild bajji chillies; slit and deseed.
Make a thick batter of besan, rice flour, chilli powder, hing, salt and water.
Dip the chillies and deep fry until golden.

name: Mangalore Buns
steps: Mash bananas with sugar, curd, cumin and salt.
Knead in maida to a soft dough and rest 4 hours.
Roll thick small rounds.
Deep fry until they puff up and turn golden.

name: Goli Baje
steps: Mix maida, curd, coconut, chilli, ginger, curry leaves and salt into a thick batter.
Rest for 2 hours.
Drop small balls into medium-hot oil.
Fry until golden and cooked through.

name: Masala Puri
steps: Make small crisp puris from maida dough (or use store-bought).
Pressure cook dried peas until soft and mash half.
Simmer the peas with chilli powder, garam masala and salt into a thick masala.
Crush puris in a plate, pour the hot masala over and top with onion, tomato, carrot and coriander.

name: Pani Puri
steps: Make puris (or buy ready ones).
Blend mint, coriander, chilli, cumin and salt with cold water for the pani.
Boil tamarind with jaggery for the sweet chutney.
Fill puris with potato and chana, then pani and chutney.

name: Sweet Corn Chaat
steps: Boil or microwave the corn for 5 minutes.
Toss with butter, onion, tomato, chilli powder and salt.
Squeeze lemon and serve warm.

name: Boiled Peanut Chaat
steps: Pressure cook peanuts with salt for 4 whistles and drain.
Mix with chopped onion, tomato and cucumber.
Add chilli powder, lemon juice and coriander.

name: Sprouts Salad
steps: Soak moong overnight and sprout for a day.
Mix the sprouts with chopped onion, tomato and cucumber.
Season with salt, lemon and coriander.

name: Kosambari
steps: Soak moong dal for 2 hours and drain.
Mix with grated cucumber, carrot and coconut.
Add green chilli, salt and lemon juice.
Pour a small mustard seed tempering on top.

name: Cucumber Raita
steps: Whisk curd until smooth.
Add grated cucumber and salt.
Sprinkle roasted cumin and coriander.

name: Air Fryer Aloo Tikki
steps: Boil and mash potatoes and peas; rinse the poha and squeeze it dry.
Mix with the poha, chilli, garam masala, coriander and salt.
Shape patties and brush with oil.
Air fry at 190°C for 14 minutes, flipping halfway.

name: Paneer Tikka
steps: Mix curd, tandoori masala, lemon juice, oil and salt.
Coat paneer, capsicum and onion cubes and rest 30 minutes.
Air fry at 200°C for 10 minutes (or bake at 220°C for 15 minutes).

name: Veg Hakka Noodles
steps: Boil noodles until just cooked, rinse in cold water and toss with a little oil.
Stir-fry garlic and sliced vegetables on very high heat for 3 minutes.
Add noodles, soy sauce, pepper and salt.
Toss for 2 minutes and serve.

name: Veg Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice and cool completely.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.
Add rice, soy sauce, pepper and salt and toss for 3 minutes.

name: Microwave Dhokla
steps: Whisk besan, curd, water, ginger, chilli, sugar and salt into a batter; rest 10 minutes.
Add lemon juice and a pinch of fruit salt or soda and mix.
Microwave in a greased bowl for 4-5 minutes until set.
Pour a mustard seed tempering on top and cut into squares.

name: Filter Coffee
steps: Brew the coffee powder with hot water in a filter for 10 minutes to get decoction.
Boil the milk.
Mix 1 part decoction with 3 parts milk and sugar.
Froth by pouring between the tumbler and dabara.

name: Masala Chai
steps: Boil 1 cup water with crushed ginger and cardamom.
Add tea powder and boil 2 minutes.
Add milk and sugar and boil again.
Strain and serve hot.

name: Badam Milk
steps: Soak almonds and peel them.
Grind to a paste with a little milk.
Boil the rest of the milk with the paste, sugar and cardamom for 5 minutes.
Serve warm or chilled.

name: Buttermilk (Majjige)
steps: Whisk curd with 3 cups cold water.
Add crushed ginger, curry leaves, coriander and salt.
Serve chilled.

name: Sweet Lassi
steps: Whisk curd with sugar and cardamom until frothy.
Add a little chilled water if thick.
Serve cold.

name: Fresh Lime Soda
steps: Squeeze lemons into two glasses.
Add sugar and a pinch of salt.
Top up with chilled soda water and stir.

name: Gulab Jamun
steps: Knead the mix with milk into a soft dough and rest 5 minutes.
Make sugar syrup with 300 g sugar, 1 1/2 cups water and cardamom.
Roll smooth balls and fry on low heat until dark golden.
Soak in warm syrup for 1 hour.

name: Mysore Pak
steps: Sieve besan and mix with a little melted ghee.
Make a one-string sugar syrup.
Add the besan to the syrup and keep stirring, adding hot ghee a little at a time.
When it froths and leaves the pan, pour into a greased tray and cut while warm.

name: Semiya Payasa
steps: Fry cashews and raisins in ghee; roast the vermicelli in the same ghee.
Boil the milk and add the vermicelli.
Cook 8 minutes, then add sugar and cardamom.
Stir in the nuts.

name: Rice Kheer
steps: Wash rice and boil in milk on low heat for 35 minutes, stirring often.
Add sugar and cardamom.
Garnish with cashews.

name: Banana Shake
steps: Peel and chop the bananas.
Blend with milk, sugar and almonds until smooth.
Serve chilled.

name: Fruit Bowl
steps: Peel and chop the fruit into bite-size pieces.
Add chopped dates.
Toss with a squeeze of lemon.

name: Curd Oats Bowl
steps: Soak oats in curd for 10 minutes.
Top with sliced banana and peanuts.
Drizzle with melted jaggery.

name: Roasted Poha Chivda
steps: Dry-roast thin poha until crisp.
Fry peanuts, roasted chana, curry leaves and chilli in oil.
Add turmeric, salt and sugar.
Toss in the poha and cool before storing.

name: Air Fryer Masala Chana
steps: Soak and pressure cook chana until just tender; dry well.
Toss with oil, chole masala, chilli powder and salt.
Air fry at 200°C for 15 minutes, shaking twice, until crunchy.

name: Oven Masala Mushroom Toast
steps: Sauté chopped mushroom, onion and capsicum in butter with salt and pepper (or toss raw with butter).
Butter the bread slices.
Top with the mushroom mix.
Bake at 200°C for 8 minutes until the edges are crisp.

name: Instant Kettle Poha
steps: Boil water in the electric kettle.
Pour over poha in a bowl, cover for 2 minutes and drain.
Mix with chopped onion, peanuts, salt, sugar and lemon juice.

name: Rice Cooker Masoor Khichdi
steps: Wash rice and masoor dal.
Put everything in the rice cooker with 5 cups water.
Cook on the normal setting and rest 10 minutes.

name: Bhurji Toast
steps: Scramble eggs with onion, tomato and salt.
Toast the buttered bread.
Pile the bhurji on the toast.

name: Chicken Fried Rice
steps: Cook rice and cool.
Stir-fry small chicken pieces until cooked; scramble the eggs.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.
Add rice, chicken, egg, soy sauce, pepper and salt and toss.

name: Air Fryer Fish Tikka
steps: Cut fish into cubes.
Marinate in curd, tandoori masala, garlic, lemon and salt for 30 minutes.
Air fry at 200°C for 10 minutes.

name: Egg Biryani
steps: Boil and peel the eggs; prick them.
Fry onion brown in ghee; add ginger, garlic, tomato, curd, masala and mint.
Add the eggs, soaked rice, salt and 2 1/2 cups water.
Pressure cook for 2 whistles and rest 10 minutes.

name: Tofu Veg Stir Fry
steps: Cube tofu and pan-fry until golden.
Stir-fry garlic and vegetables on high heat.
Add soy sauce and corn flour mixed with water.
Toss in the tofu until glazed.

name: Soya Pulao
steps: Soak rice; boil and squeeze the soya chunks.
Fry onion, ginger and garlic, then vegetables, soya and garam masala.
Add rice, salt and 2 cups water; pressure cook for 2 whistles.

name: Chana Sundal
steps: Soak and pressure cook chana until soft; drain.
Temper mustard seeds, red chilli and curry leaves in oil.
Add chana, coconut and salt and toss.

name: Paneer Capsicum Rice
steps: Cook rice and cool.
Sauté onion and capsicum in ghee.
Add paneer cubes, garam masala, soy sauce and salt.
Fold in the rice.

name: Moong Dal Soup
steps: Pressure cook moong dal with tomato and carrot for 3 whistles.
Blend smooth with 2 cups water.
Temper garlic and cumin in oil and add.
Season with pepper, salt and lemon.
